## 🛑 STOP! Do not report security vulnerabilities here

Please refer to our [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) policy for instructions on how to safely disclose security issues directly to the Plexis Labs team.

Publicly disclosing an exploit puts the platform and users at risk. Please email us directly.
